items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Unfortunately, there was a character in the news funnies. We were at war with Japan. His name was Mr. Tojo. Mr. Tojo also wore horn rimmed glasses.

ctx.x: It was part of the music.

No it was a culture. Yeah it was, it was a whole lifestyle. So anyway I saw these horn rimmed glasses, so I had to have a pair of horn rimmed glasses. So I started squinting around and bumping into things and so forth. But my mother, she was hip to what I was doing, but she finally broke down and bought me some horn rimmed glasses.
